title: Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) Days-to-Pay Schedule for Insured Payoffs
content:
**Schedule.** On an insured Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account paid off in full, the days to pay are the calendar days counted from the day after the account's first statement date through the payment date, that is the plain difference of the two dates. A payment made when the days to pay are 10 or fewer adds 4 percentage points to the insured payoff discount percent; one made when they are more than 10 but no more than 20 adds 2 percentage points; a later payment, or an account with no first statement date, adds none.

| Days to pay | Percentage points added |
|---|---|
| 10 or fewer | 4 |
| 11 through 20 | 2 |
| 21 or more | none |
| no first statement date on the account | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

With a first statement date of 1 June:

- payment on 11 June: 10 days to pay, 4 points;
- payment on 12 June: 11 days, 2 points;
- payment on 21 June: 20 days, 2 points;
- payment on 22 June: 21 days, none.
